blockingFindings.description: In the five neutral views the overskirt still reads as a plain cone, with no clearly visible repeated knife pleats or readable lamé surface. The larger panel-local relief did not make the skirt construction legible at product-view scale.

Crouch and sit views show the flared skirt panels lifting and overlapping across the thighs and behind the body; prone remains a broad disk-like flare. The new pleat relief has not resolved the pose deformation and adds no convincing drape.
The neutral front, back, and side renders still show triangular faceting across the lower bodice/waist and an uneven projecting jacket-to-skirt transition at the rear and sides.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
